question: Why would the compassion-rich withhold even the ungivable from one who serves their feet?
premises: Those rich in compassion give even what is not ordinarily to be given.
A servant at the feet seeks their grace.
Compassion overrides ordinary limits of giving.
inference: The compassion-rich will give even the ungivable to one who serves at their feet.
plain_english: Even what should not be given is given by those rich in compassion; how much more to one who serves at their feet?
